result.instructions: Tools for 15Five, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which people in the Sales group have a check-in due this week?"; "List the objectives that are at risk this quarter and who owns them."; "Show the high fives one team member received in the last 30 days.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes 15Five data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run 15five_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run 15five_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run 15five_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. 15five_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: 15five_check_connection
tools.title: Check 15Five connection
tools.description: Check that the 15Five API token works and report the API response. Use it first when other calls fail with an auth error. GET /api/public/hello/.

tools.name: 15five_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List 15Five users (people) with their name, email, employee id, location, active status and admin flags. Filter by email, employee_id, name, or is_active. GET /api/public/user/.

is_active.description: true for active users, false for deactivated users.

updated_after.description: ISO date-time: only users updated after this time.

updated_before.description: ISO date-time: only users updated before this time.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. last_name or update_ts. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one 15Five user by id: contact details, title, reporting flags and last login. GET /api/public/user/{id}/.

tools.name: 15five_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List company departments, optionally filtered by name. GET /api/public/department/.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List 15Five groups, optionally filtered by name. GET /api/public/group/.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_list_objectives
tools.title: List objectives
tools.description: List objectives (goals). Objectives are returned regardless of privacy settings. GET /api/public/objective/.

scope.description: Objective scope value, as the 15Five API defines it.

state.description: Objective state value, as the 15Five API defines it.

start_after.description: yyyy-mm-dd: objectives that start after this date.

end_before.description: yyyy-mm-dd: objectives that end before this date.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. update_ts. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_get_objective
tools.title: Get an objective
tools.description: Get one objective (goal) by id, with its key results and progress. GET /api/public/objective/{id}/.

tools.name: 15five_list_checkins
tools.title: List check-ins
tools.description: List check-ins (weekly reports). Filter by user and due date. GET /api/public/report/.

user_id.description: The user who submitted the check-in.

due_date_start.description: yyyy-mm-dd: check-ins due on or after this date.

due_date_end.description: yyyy-mm-dd: check-ins due on or before this date.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. due_date. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_get_checkin
tools.title: Get a check-in
tools.description: Get one check-in (report) by id. GET /api/public/report/{id}/.

tools.name: 15five_list_pulse
tools.title: List pulse scores
tools.description: List Check-in Pulse scores. Engagement survey results are not in this API (use the CSV export in the 15Five app). GET /api/public/pulse/.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. created_on. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_list_high_fives
tools.title: List high fives
tools.description: List high fives (peer recognition messages). Filter by receiver or source check-in. GET /api/public/high-five/.

receiver_id.description: The user who received the high five.

report_id.description: The check-in the high five came from.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. created_on. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_list_priorities
tools.title: List priorities
tools.description: List weekly priorities that people set in their check-ins. Filter by user, manager or group. GET /api/public/priority/.

include_past_checkins.description: true to include priorities from earlier check-ins.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. created_on. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_list_one_on_ones
tools.title: List 1-on-1s
tools.description: List 1-on-1 meetings between a manager and a report, with their scheduled and ended dates. GET /api/public/one-on-one/.

type.description: 1-on-1 type value, as the API defines it.

tools.name: 15five_list_vacations
tools.title: List vacations
tools.description: List vacation and time-off records for users. GET /api/public/vacation/.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. created_on. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_list_review_cycles
tools.title: List review cycles
tools.description: List performance review cycles. The API key creator needs company admin, review admin and cycle administrator access, or the list is empty. GET /api/public/review-cycle/.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. started_on. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_get_review_cycle
tools.title: Get a review cycle
tools.description: Get one review cycle by id. Needs the review permissions described in 15five_list_review_cycles. GET /api/public/review-cycle/{id}/.

tools.name: 15five_list_cycle_participants
tools.title: List review cycle participants
tools.description: List who takes part in one review cycle, with their manager and group. GET /api/public/review-cycle/{cycle_id}/participants/.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. user. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.

tools.name: 15five_list_cycle_reviews
tools.title: List review cycle reviews
tools.description: List the reviews in one review cycle, with their answers and completion state. Needs the review permissions described in 15five_list_review_cycles. GET /api/public/review-cycle/{cycle_id}/reviews/.

order_by.description: Sort field, e.g. due_date. Prefix with "-" for descending.

page.description: Page number for pagination (default 1). Lists return up to 50 to 100 rows per page.
